mapper.select: SELECT k.id AS sku_id, COALESCE(k.first_brokerage_price, 0.00) AS first_price, COALESCE(k.second_brokerage_price, 0.00) AS second_price FROM product_sku k JOIN product_spu s ON s.id=k.spu_id WHERE s.sub_commission_type=TRUE AND s.status <> 'DELETED' AND k.status <> 'DELETED' AND k.id IN #{id}

SELECT k.price, CASE WHEN s.sub_commission_type=TRUE THEN COALESCE(k.first_brokerage_price, 0.00) END AS first_fixed FROM product_sku k JOIN product_spu s ON s.id=k.spu_id WHERE s.id=#{spuId} AND s.status='ON_SHELF' AND k.status='ON_SHELF'
mapper.sql: (spu_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_spu s JOIN product_category c ON c.id=s.category_id JOIN product_brand b ON b.id=s.brand_id LEFT JOIN product_category parent ON parent.id=c.parent_id WHERE s.id=product_sku.spu_id AND s.status='ON_SHELF' AND c.status='ENABLED' AND b.status='ENABLED' AND (c.parent_id IS NULL OR parent.status='ENABLED')))
